basis: Reka NumberFieldInput renders the spinbutton input with increment/decrement as labelled <button>s.

exceptions.because: number-field.e2e.ts presses the field's real keyboard surface in browser — the arrows stepping the spinbutton, Shift multiplying one tick by ten, Home and End landing on the clamped poles, Enter committing once per gesture, the disabled field walked past — while the stepper buttons' deadness under the keyboard is the interaction-level defect below; the keyboard family's own rules (aria-hidden-focus and its siblings) are the harness axe gate's to answer; the role-axis evidence tranche owns un-qualifying this row

interaction.basis: an inner spinbutton <input> with increment and decrement steppers beside it — three targets managed as one field.

harness.because: witnesses the input's full keyboard surface — arrows, Shift ticks, Home and End, Enter commits — while the stepper buttons answer the pointer only

exceptions.because: the steppers are unreachable and inert to the keyboard: reka renders them tabindex="-1" — off the tab order — and its pressed-hold handler listens to pointerdown only, so Enter or Space on a directly focused stepper fires the browser's own click into a listener that is not there and the value does not move (observed in the harness; verified against the pinned reka-ui dist); the input itself carries the field's full keyboard surface, and the row holds until the steppers answer the keyboard too; tracked in ecoma-io/loom#432
